source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check any mechanical problem found during assemble the serial port
1. Install the cable to the serial port.
2. Check if any mechanical problems can be found, such as: plug/unplug too tight or too loose; mechanical interference issues with chassis cover, cables or rise cages, etc

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure the cable can plug/unplug without any problem.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Serial Port mechanical check: serial-port mechanical check is a physical inspection of the DB-9 connector; human-only.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator inspects the serial port + records; agent cannot inspect hardware.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved serial cable mates and unmates normally with the specified serial port, with acceptable tightness/retention and no interference with the chassis cover, adjacent cables or riser cages.
original_method: A qualified operator inspects the serial connector and nearby assembly, performs one controlled cable mate/unmate cycle, evaluates fit and clearance, and captures before/after mechanical evidence.
manual_activity: Mating force, looseness, retention, pin/fastener condition and interference with cover/cabling/riser hardware are tactile and visual properties that require an engineer at the chassis.
required_inputs: Exact serial port, connector/electrical type and approved cable/pinout
Allowed fit, retention and clearance criteria
Representative chassis cover, cable routing and riser configuration
ESD procedure, active-console impact and alternate management path
safety_requirements: Do not force or misalign the connector and do not assume every D-sub connector has compatible pinout/electrical levels.
Stop on excessive resistance, looseness, bent pins, port/PCB movement or hardware interference.
Do not disturb riser/cabling or disconnect an active serial console without authorization.
Perform only one approved cycle; preserve evidence and do not retry an abnormal fit.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare port/cable/chassis identity and photo/clearance checklist.
Collect read-only serial/console and system health before/after if the port is active.
Organize operator findings without claiming tactile or visual execution.
engineer_actions: Approve the cable and mechanical/clearance criteria.
Perform the physical inspection and single controlled mate/unmate cycle.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no command can prove the physical fit or interference. It should not assume DB-9 unless the platform specification confirms it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No software substitute. Serial enumeration or console checks may document post-action health only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Cable installation, tight/loose and chassis/cable/riser interference checks, plug/unplug criterion and 5/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved cable and representative chassis assembly, photograph pins/fasteners/clearances, perform one aligned mate/unmate, record retention and any contact with cover/cables/riser, then restore the console path.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact serial connector, cable and chassis/riser configuration.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/chassis/cable revisions; software is not the acceptance basis.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner connector, cable, mechanical and chassis-clearance specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, representative assembly and stop thresholds without increasing cycles.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; electrical communication remains a separate testcase.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Do not invent numeric insertion-force limits when only qualitative criteria are supplied.

project_override_considerations: A project may define cable part number, assembly variants and numeric fit/clearance thresholds. Missing specifics make execution not ready, not permanently blocked. Additional cycles require separate wear authorization.
expected_evidence: Port/cable/type and chassis/riser identities with acceptance criteria
Timestamped before/after connector/pin/fastener and clearance photos
Operator observation of fit, retention, interference and absence of damage
Restored serial/console state, log review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently require physical serial-port fit and interference inspection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual operation is clear. Cable and fit criteria are readiness inputs, not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with human-only classification but avoid assuming DB-9 and restore interference/safety coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its one-cycle, ESD, clearance and console safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates mechanical fit from communication coverage and explicitly protects representative chassis/riser geometry.

review_improvement: Prevents software enumeration or a bare-board fit from being reported as coverage of actual chassis, cable and riser interference.
independent_technical_reasoning: All primary acceptance signals are physical and assembly-dependent. Software cannot measure connector force or interference, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
